description_en: View parameters for a lightweight database instance
description_zh: 查看轻量数据库实例的参数信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-database-instance-parameters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabaseInstanceParameters

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the lightweight database instance is located. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the most recent region list

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the lightweight database instance
parameters.name: database_instance_id

ConfigParameters.description_en: A list of configuration parameters being synchronized. After you modify and submit parameters, the instance starts to synchronize them. Once synchronization is complete, these parameters are removed from this list
ConfigParameters.description_zh: 正在同步的参数列表。修改并提交参数后，需要等待实例同步参数，同步结束后从此列表删除

items.description_en: The details of a configuration parameter that is being synchronized
items.description_zh: 正在同步的参数列表。修改并提交参数后，需要等待实例同步参数，同步结束后从此列表删除

CheckingCode.description_zh:

ForceModify.description_en:
Indicates whether you can modify the parameter value. Valid values:

`true`: You can modify the parameter value.

`false`: You cannot modify the parameter value
ForceModify.description_zh:
是否支持修改参数值。可能值：

true ：支持修改参数值。
false：不支持修改参数值

ForceRestart.description_en:
Indicates if the database must be restarted for a parameter modification to take effect. Valid values:

`true`: A restart is required. To apply changes for a parameter that requires a restart, you must set the `ForceRestart` parameter to `true`.

`false`: A restart is not required.

Default value: `false`
ForceRestart.description_zh:
修改参数是否重启数据库。可能值：

true：强制重启（若修改的参数当中，有需要重启的参数，则必须传入true，否则修改将不生效）。
false：不强制重启。

默认值：false

ParameterDescription.description_en: The description of the running parameter
ParameterDescription.example: When this variable has a value of 1 (the default), the server automatically grants the EXECUTE and ALTER ROUTINE privileges to the creator of a stored routine, if the user cannot already execute and alter or drop the routine. (The ALTER ROUTINE privilege is required to drop the routine.) The server also automatically drops those privileges from the creator when the routine is dropped. If automatic_sp_privileges is 0, the server does not automatically add or drop these privileges.
